args.task_contract: The retry counter is incremented twice after a timeout. Say exactly where, and what to change.
args.issue_goal:
Retries on the upload path double-count an attempt

`upload_chunk` increments `attempts` in its `except TimeoutError` arm and again at the top of the loop, so a single timeout burns two of the five permitted attempts. Bound the retry count correctly and keep the failure surfaced to the caller.
